title: Anatomical stimulation-site attribution from complete VTC evoked responses

evidence.supports: Preserved original source registration, source citations and proposed complete scientific endpoint; later implementation corrections are distinguished below.
Complete-five-patient artifact admission, compartment labels, clipped log loss and coverage refusal.
Owner-only metadata source; no waveform/target production.
Complete-block control component and remaining authentic-input requirements.

evidence.locator: Methods:SPES, VTC response interval and BPC analyses
evidence.supports: Five-patient evoked-response source and distinction between anatomical site and fitted response patterns.
Original stimulation/contact metadata and waveform source.
Inspected source-scope documentation distinguishing delivered software from authentic task execution.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human trial for this task is established by this source revision. Generated software checks are not participant performance.
excluded_claims: Artifact grader means complete clinical benchmark
Anatomical attribution proves a new causal connection

disposition_reason: Five-patient primary prediction-artifact scorer and complete-block pairing/metadata components exist; authentic waveform-to-anatomy joins, full participant packets, fitted references and protected runner remain missing.

scientific_target.question: Can complete ventral-temporal evoked-response blocks identify the documented anatomical compartment of the stimulated pair in an unseen patient?
scientific_target.known_answer: Authenticated stimulation-pair anatomy in the frozen four-compartment order hippocampus, amygdala, lateral_temporal_cortex, other_mixed.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original contact localization and stimulation metadata from OpenNeuro ds004457 v1.0.2; not fitted BPC template labels. Authentic compartment/mixed-pair mapping is still required.
scientific_target.case_unit: One stimulation-site by VTC recording-contact block containing every pulse repetition and all 11–500 ms samples.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Patient (five total); contact blocks and repetitions remain nested.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Anatomical attribution from evoked response under patient transfer; no new causal-connection discovery or disease inference.
exclusions: A fitted BPC category is not independent anatomical ground truth.
Repeated pulses cannot increase the independent sample size above five patients.
Residual stimulation artifact or amplitude-only classification is not evidence of network-specific representation.

inputs: Complete baseline-corrected all-repetition VTC waveform matrix over 11–500 ms, native relative grid, verified units, artifact/missingness masks and target-free recording-location descriptors.
forbidden_inputs: Stimulating-contact ID/anatomy, site-revealing event codes, patient-identifying filenames, test-fitted BPC consensus curves and owner target maps.
observation_contract.case_identity: Scorer requires unique opaque case_id and patient/session/site_block/VTC_contact joins plus packet digest for every declared block; authentic full census is not supplied.
observation_contract.split: Declared leave-one-patient-out over all five people; all repetitions/sessions/contacts remain grouped. Policy checks training roster but cannot authenticate actual training access.
observation_contract.coverage: All five patients, every released VTC contact, stimulation site and repetition must enter owner census. Current scorer verifies complete declared roster but not physical source completeness; any unresolved coverage blocks primary loss.

primary.name: Patient-macro multiclass log loss
primary.aggregation: Mean negative log true-compartment probability across blocks within patient, then equal mean across all five patients; probability floor frozen by owner policy.
primary.rationale: The declared probability-floor loss penalizes confident wrong compartments while retaining equal patient weight despite unequal block counts. Flooring the true-class log argument is an operational finite-loss convention; strict propriety is not claimed for the clipped score.

secondary: Per-patient confusion, class support, observed-class macro recall and fixed 10-bin classwise calibration.
All-four-class recall is null for missing classes; unsupported training classes remain explicit.
Paired original-minus-reassigned block performance only on exact shared support; primary full coverage remains separate.

comparators.name: Training-class prevalence
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed prior under each LOPO fold.

comparators.name: Mean waveform/template correlation
comparators.inputs: Same full training response blocks and labels
comparators.procedure: Proposed train-class mean waveforms with train-only normalization and fixed deterministic matching.

comparators.name: Regularized temporal classifier
comparators.inputs: Same full packets; train-only temporal coefficients or BPC extractor
comparators.procedure: Proposed nested patient tuning; never compute BPC consensus on held patient.

nuisance_controls: Pre-stimulus-only and amplitude-only comparators; audit artifact-mask/channel-ID prediction.
Pairing moves whole repetition matrices among compatible distinct-site blocks within patient/session/contact and acquisition strata; labels/context fixed.
Freeze finite target-blind derangements and report unsupported strata rather than drawing until anatomical classes mix.
evaluation.uncertainty: Show all five patient effects and paired support. Five patients limit precision; pulses/blocks are not independent replication. Authentic uncertainty protocol and references remain unfinished.
evaluation.failure_policy: Admit complete predictions before target access; four normalized finite probabilities per exact case. Missing/inconsistent coverage produces no primary score; unsupported classes never justify excluding a patient.

implementation.scorer_target: score_files computes compartment log loss from a separately authenticated target document after complete artifact admission. Native metadata prepares owner metadata only; pairing supplies maps/materialization/support-matched losses but no authentic anatomy or waveform release.
implementation.delivered_scope: Conditional full-five-patient artifact grading and paired-control source, with generated numerical/interface checks. No end-to-end authenticated anatomical inference run.
missing: Original event/contact/anatomy joins and fixed other/mixed mapping, all-pulse/full-contact census and rights.
Native waveform preparation, complete candidate transport and train-only references.
Physical pairing execution and small-patient uncertainty.
implementation.execution_evidence: Software source documents generated controls only; source/package identities do not establish authentic clinical operands, biological completeness or candidate execution.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed complete all-repetition VTC waveform matrix or lossless plots.
direct_observation.boundary: No tools; full packet must fit before declaring direct evidence.
missing: Authenticated input packet and capacity protocol.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential repetition-aware waveform display with typed channel/time/repetition views.
typed_viewer.boundary: No anatomy/event lookup, target-bearing titles or raw-owner data.

tool_assisted.representation: Proposed same matrix plus train-only templates/numerical analysis.
tool_assisted.boundary: Case-fresh tool state and identical training evidence, no test BPC fitting.
missing: Protected tool runner and competent train-only template model.

frozen_program.boundary: Freeze fitting policy on training patients; artifact scoring alone is not program execution.
missing: Frozen lifecycle and authentic reference qualification.

summary: Name independent stimulation anatomy as answer and separate it from fitted BPC response labels.
Make complete artifact grading available scope explicit without claiming waveform preparation or any candidate access mode.
Preserve all-five-patient coverage and support-limited whole-block pairing controls.
revision.source_review: Reviewed preserved scientific registration and named implementation code/documentation; reused cited primary source evidence already verified in these records. No scientific arrays or evaluator labels were opened in this revision.
